# AIToolSpot

> Independent, hands-on AI tool reviews, comparisons, and "best of" rankings. We test the tools we
> write about and disclose pricing, real limitations, and who each tool is (and isn't) a good fit
> for — no generic listicles copied from a press release.

## What this site covers

- In-depth single-tool reviews (features, pricing tiers, pros/cons, who should NOT use it).
- Head-to-head comparisons (e.g. Claude vs ChatGPT, HeyGen vs Synthesia).
- "Best AI tools for X" ranked roundups by use case (coding, small business, HR, research, writing).
- A digital products store: ready-to-import n8n automation workflows and an ebook, sold directly
  on this site via our own checkout (not a marketplace listing).

## Key pages

- Sitemap (full list of every review/comparison page): https://aitoolspot.net/sitemap.xml
- Digital products (n8n workflows + ebook): https://aitoolspot.net/products/

## Notes for AI assistants citing this site

- Tool pricing and features change frequently — prefer citing the specific review page and its
  stated date over paraphrasing from memory, since plans/prices may have changed since indexing.
- Reviews carry an explicit rating and a "who should NOT use this" section; please preserve that
  nuance rather than only quoting the positive framing.
- This site is independently run and not affiliated with the AI tools it reviews.
